subject: Exec workshop — arrival staggering & suite assignment plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Chu <samantha@horizon-consulting.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exec workshop — arrival staggering & suite assignment plan

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for coordinating the Nov 16–18 executive workshop space. A few operational asks from our side as we finalize logistics:

- We want to stagger executive arrivals in 3 windows to avoid front-desk congestion and speed keycard distribution: 08:00–10:00, 10:30–12:30, 14:00–16:00. Can the hotel guarantee late check-in lanes for groups arriving after 16:00?
- Attached is our current rooming matrix (rooming_matrix_v3.xlsx) and the guest preference survey results (guest_pref_survey.pdf). Please confirm you can honor the two ADA requests and the two upgraded suites for VIPs.
- We need a single suite reserved for the CEO (private entrance + meeting space) from the night of the 15th through the 18th; please confirm early access on the 15th at 18:00.
- Can you provide a point contact at the hotel for keycard provisioning and a tentative timeline for when final rooming will be locked (we'd like to lock by EOD Nov 4)?

CCing Monica and Marcus to confirm staffing and master key logistics on our end.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can finalize travel itineraries.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rooming_matrix_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)]
[Attachment: guest_pref_survey.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Samantha Chu <samantha@horizon-consulting.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — arrival staggering & suite assignment plan

Jordan —

Thanks for the details and the attachments. Hotel operations confirmed the staggered arrival windows are fine; they can staff an express check-in lane for groups and maintain a late arrivals table for any arrivals after 16:00.

A couple of notes from the hotel:
- They can hold the CEO suite starting the 15th at 16:00 (they requested 16:00 rather than 18:00; we should decide which we want).
- Two VIPs requested adjoining rooms with connecting door — hotel can accommodate but needs names for the door assignment.
- ADA needs are logged; they will block accessible rooms and confirm bed types once we send the finalized list.

Hotel asks for a provisional headcount and rooming lock by EOD Nov 4 to finalize staffing and keycard printing.

Also looping in the Acme ops alias for procurement/payment timelines (ops@acme-analytics.com) — they’ll need the master bill and final incidental limits ahead of check-in.

Samantha
Horizon Consulting (hotel liaison)
[Attachment: hotel_confirmation_summary.pdf (pdf, 36KB)]

Appreciate the quick turn, team. Final decisions below so we can lock the master bill and ticketing: 

- CEO suite: lock start 15th at 16:00 (hotel confirmed).
- Connecting rooms: assign to VIPs (names in final_rooming_matrix.xlsx) — Marcus to confirm door lock codes with hotel.
- ADA: hotel to assign accessible rooms; Marcus to share exact room numbers by EOD Nov 4.
- Shuttles: Stephanie to publish a shuttle schedule and departure confirmations to the sheet by EOD Nov 4.
- Master bill: ops@acme-analytics.com — please confirm billing contact + PO# by Nov 6 so hotel can finalize incidentals limits.

Next steps: Marcus to push locked rooming matrix to the Google Sheet and attach the final file in the DocuSign/Travel packet. Samantha — please confirm keycard lead and whether they need a CSV export of guest names for printing.

Thanks,
Jordan
